AI-Native Platform

One common data model

Every service writes to the same data model, so agents act with full context across backup, security, and operations, not one silo at a time.

Grounded in your data

Detection and agent decisions tie back to customer telemetry and Threat Research Unit intelligence, verifiable source data, not guesswork.

Scoped permissions

Every agent runs with least-privilege access and policy guardrails. You define what it can read, change, and act on, per tenant.

One platform, built around how you protect, manage and automate IT
